# ADPList

> > ADPList is a free global mentorship platform connecting learners with 32,000+ verified mentors across design, product, engineering, AI, and marketing disciplines in 140 countries.

ADPList democratizes access to world-class mentorship by offering free one-on-one sessions with experienced professionals. The platform also provides curated learning resources, including AI design courses and career development guides, making it a comprehensive hub for professional growth in tech and design.

## Key Topics

- Free mentorship
- AI design
- UX/UI design
- Product management
- Engineering mentorship
- Professional development
- Design education
- Career advice
- Global community
- Figma
- Claude Code
- Design Moonshot
- Vibe coding
- Design by Intelligence
- Cracked Resume

## Getting Started

- [ADPList Homepage](https://adplist.org): ADPList homepage: free mentorship platform with 32k mentors in AI, design, PM, dev
- [About ADPList](https://adplist.org/about-us): About ADPList: mission, community, and 32k mentors across 140 countries
- [Explore Mentors](https://adplist.org/explore): Explore and connect with verified mentors in UX, PM, engineering, AI, marketing

## Become a Mentor

- [Become a Mentor](https://adplist.org/become-a-mentor): Become a mentor: join ADPList platform to mentor others in your expertise

## Learning Resources & Courses

- [Vibe Coding for Designers](https://adplist.org/ai-course): 7-day vibe coding course: Figma to deployed apps with Claude Code and Cursor
- [Design by Intelligence](https://adplist.org/design-by-intelligence): Design by Intelligence: free ebook guide on AI-native design tools and workflows
- [Design Moonshot Guide](https://adplist.org/design-moonshot-guide): Design Moonshot playbook: UI decisions to 50x results from Duolingo, Uber, Airbnb
